scope.description: Hotfix two independent-validator replay mismatches without changing producer science: count M1 joined ALT reads from site_reads even when a read has zero serialized CpG calls, and exclude M1 other/outlier labels from co-occurrence endpoint-A core-group replay. Add bounded synthetic regression fixtures in the existing dataset-gate integration test.

assumptions: Producer n_alt_joined and Bernoulli dimensions intentionally census every focal ALT matrix row, including all-missing rows later removed by incomplete-distance peeling.
Producer endpoint-A co-occurrence intentionally uses only core M1 labels; other and outlier remain serialized assignments but are excluded from the Kx2 endpoint-A table.
The independent validator must derive both contracts from producer artifacts without linking producer science kernels.

step_verify.step: Add positive/regression fixture states for a zero-CpG focal ALT read and non-core M1 labels.
step_verify.verify: The positive fixture passes only when n_alt_joined/LLM use site_reads ALT census and endpoint-A group replay excludes other/outlier.

step_verify.step: Adjust the independent replay in artifact_validator.cpp without producer-kernel linkage.
step_verify.verify: The validator target builds with warnings-as-errors and the dataset-gate regression target exits 0.

step_verify.step: Run targeted validator tests and record source/test digests.
step_verify.verify: Targeted CTest exits 0; modified file SHA-256 values and command output are reported before the lease is released.
